prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical diptych that contrasts a realistic railway-yard photograph with a minimalist commemorative poster design about the same scene, centered on EF66 27 / JNR and titled IRON MEMORY.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 image, split into exactly 2 horizontal panels of equal width: the top panel is a realistic color photograph, the bottom panel is a vintage screen-print poster on warm off-white paper.

Top panel: Show exactly 1 large blue-and-cream Japanese electric locomotive parked on railway tracks at an outdoor depot in Japan. The train is viewed from a low front-left three-quarter angle, filling most of the frame, with the front number plate reading “EF66 27” and a small “JNR” mark on the side. Include exactly 1 person standing near the locomotive on the right side, looking up at it: a short-haired adult wearing a gray jacket, striped scarf, blue jeans, and sneakers. Surround the train with multiple parallel rails, gravel ballast, overhead catenary wires, a raised pantograph, and pale industrial depot buildings with open shed doors. Use natural daylight, blue sky with soft clouds, realistic shadows, slightly nostalgic film-photo color, and detailed weathering on the locomotive.

Bottom panel: Reinterpret the top scene as a flat graphic poster using only muted blue ink on textured cream paper. Create a large simplified silhouette of the same locomotive angled from the left, with the pantograph and overhead wires visible. Add exactly 1 small human silhouette standing near the train at lower right. Use irregular blank cream negative space like a cloud or memory shape cutting through the train silhouette. Include depot buildings and track lines as thin blue geometric outlines on the right. The style should feel like a vintage railway memorial print, risograph or silkscreen, with grain, faded ink, and subtle paper speckles.

Text content in bottom panel: Place the large title “IRON MEMORY” at lower left in a clean spaced sans-serif font. Below it, add “EF66 27 / JNR”. Add small caption text: “Depot, Japan” and “A moment beside the road that remembers.” Along the bottom center write “TRACKS OF TIME” followed by a thin horizontal line, and at the bottom right write “No. 6627”.

Constraints: Include exactly 2 panels, exactly 1 locomotive in each panel, and exactly 1 person in each panel. Keep the top panel photorealistic and the bottom panel graphic and monochrome. Do not add extra trains, extra people, logos, watermarks, or unrelated text.

promptZh:
目标：创作一幅垂直双联画，将同一场景的写实铁路车辆段照片与极简主义纪念海报设计进行对比，以 EF66 27 / JNR 为核心，标题为 IRON MEMORY。

画布：3:4 纵向图像，精确平分为 2 个等宽的水平面板：顶部面板为写实彩色照片，底部面板为印在暖米白色纸张上的复古丝网印刷海报。

顶部面板：展示 1 辆停在日本户外车辆段铁轨上的蓝色与奶油色相间的日本电力机车。从左前方低角度拍摄，机车占据画面大部分空间，前部车牌显示“EF66 27”，侧面带有小型“JNR”标志。在机车右侧包含 1 名正在仰望机车的人：一名留短发的成年人，身穿灰色夹克、条纹围巾、蓝色牛仔裤和运动鞋。机车周围环绕着多条平行铁轨、碎石道砟、高架接触网、升起的受电弓以及带有敞开式车库门的浅色工业车辆段建筑。使用自然日光、带有柔和云朵的蓝天、写实的阴影、略带怀旧感的胶片色彩，并展现机车上细致的锈蚀痕迹。

底部面板：将顶部场景重新诠释为平面图形海报，仅使用米色纹理纸张上的柔和蓝色油墨。创作一个从左侧观察的相同机车的大型简化剪影，可见受电弓和高架电线。在右下方添加 1 个站在火车旁的小型人物剪影。使用不规则的空白米色负空间（如云朵或记忆形状）穿过火车剪影。右侧以细蓝色几何轮廓勾勒出车辆段建筑和轨道线。风格应类似于复古铁路纪念印刷品、孔版印刷或丝网印刷，带有颗粒感、褪色的油墨和细微的纸张斑点。

底部面板文字内容：在左下方以简洁且字间距宽的无衬线字体放置大标题“IRON MEMORY”。在其下方添加“EF66 27 / JNR”。添加简短说明文字：“Depot, Japan” 和 “A moment beside the road that remembers.”。在底部中心书写 “TRACKS OF TIME”，后接一条细水平线，并在右下角书写 “No. 6627”。

约束：包含 2 个面板，每个面板内仅限 1 辆机车和 1 个人。保持顶部面板为照片级写实，底部面板为单色图形风格。不要添加额外的火车、额外的人员、徽标、水印或无关文字。
